title: Controlled Permission Execution Authorization Draft Gate
summary: Drafts the controlled permission execution authorization packet after a founder draft-only decision while keeping permission grant, authorization approval, execution, storage writes, canonical writes, public release, and production disabled.
previous_release: v3.2.7 Founder Permission Execution Authorization Decision Gate
next_gate: Controlled permission execution authorization draft review gate

draft_checks.rule: Starts only from a draft-only founder decision packet.
Can prepare language for review, but cannot approve authorization.
Execution, storage writes, canonical updates, migrations, accounts, secrets, public release, and production remain closed.
Keeps founder decision, authorization review, preflight, hold, and source ids visible.
Moves only to a later draft review gate, never to a runnable operation.
Expires on decision, review, source, rights, rollback, monitoring, packet, or code change.
